C Regie.ai Regie Inc. 58 /100 Partial disclosure · high confidence Regie.ai earns a C ( 58 /100) because it discloses its data practices only in part . #60 of 211 apps ranked 58 score · Sales & marketing avg 45 +13 vs category average Grade scale A · 70–100 B · 60–69 C · 48–59 D · 35–47 F · 0–34 Regie.ai explicitly prohibits training on user data obtained through Google Workspace APIs and discloses access, deletion, portability, and correction rights; retains data indefinitely for fraud prevention and legal compliance; shares data with named vendor categories and offers opt-out from targeted advertising; lists security controls including encryption and MFA with breach notification timeline; and has an EU GDPR representative named. What Regie.ai 's privacy policy and terms of service say about your data No-train commitment Regie.ai does not use any data, including data obtained through Google Workspace APIs, to train generalized AI or machine learning models Deletion rights (conditional) Request deletion: Request removal of your data where applicable Security controls named Encryption: Your data is encrypted both in transit and at rest using industry-standard encryption protocols. Access Controls: Only authorized personnel with a legitimate business need have access to your data, protected by role-based permissions. Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA): Required for internal administrative accounts Breach notification In the event of a data breach impacting your personal information, Regie.ai will notify affected users within the legally required timeframe, following applicable data protection laws The area-by-area breakdown for Regie.ai is being prepared and will appear after its next scoring pass on the current rubric.
